englishOnly: This checker finds weak words in CVs written in English. Its word list and its advice are about English phrases.
privacy: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
found: {count, plural, one {# weak word found} other {# weak words found}}
numbers: {withNumbers} of your {lines} longer lines have a number in them.
numbersLow: Add a count, a percentage or a time saved to more of them. Numbers are what a recruiter remembers.
numbersOk: Good. Numbers are what a recruiter remembers.

fixes.lead: Start with what you did: Led, Ran, Built, Managed.
fixes.results: List results, not duties. What changed because you were there?
fixes.delivered: Say what you delivered instead of what you were given.
fixes.part: Name your part: Built, Designed, Wrote, Tested.
fixes.did: Say what you did: Supported 12 clients, Cut errors by 20%.
fixes.share: Name your share of the work, or the result it produced.
fixes.owned: Say what you owned in it.
fixes.verb: Use a precise verb: Resolved, Processed, Negotiated.
fixes.name: Name them, or give the count.
fixes.list: Finish the list or cut it to the two items that matter.
fixes.show: Show it: a deadline you hit or the volume you carried.
fixes.teamResult: Name a team result and your part in it.
fixes.oneResult: Delete it and put one real result in its place.
fixes.proof: Give proof: an error rate, an audit you passed.
fixes.started: Show something you started without being asked.
fixes.skip: Delete it. Every recruiter skips it.
fixes.unusual: Describe the unusual fix you found.
fixes.evidence: Show the evidence: a side project, a course, a result.
fixes.checkable: Delete it. It says nothing a recruiter can check.
fixes.who: Say who you worked with and what it produced.
fixes.communication: Show it: a report you wrote, a team you trained.
fixes.record: Replace it with the record: one number.
fixes.learned: Name something you learned and how fast you used it.
fixes.cameFor: Say what people came to you for.

handoff.title: Rewrite these for a real job
handoff.body: FitMyCV rewrites your summary and top bullets against a job posting, in the posting's own words, using only what is already in your CV.
handoff.label: Rewrite my CV for a job
